svg.title: How a GPU machine joins GPU Deck
svg.desc: How a GPU machine joins. 1: you create a join token in the web UI (Nodes, Add node). 2: the control plane shows the token and the install command once. 3: you run the command on the GPU machine. 4: it fetches the control plane's CA, checks it against the pinned sha256, and fetches the agent. 5: the agent generates a key and a certificate signing request. 6: it joins with the token and the request. 7: the control plane signs the node certificate and the token is used up. 8: the agent dials out over mutual TLS on a WebSocket and says hello. 9: a config push follows and the node is online. 10 and 11, repeating: heartbeats, metrics and inventory go up; commands such as load, unload, drain and swap come back on the same socket.
